set.body:
Why: BiProjection.map and CrossProjection.x/.y are the concrete MatrixMap (Maps.scala:197,208), not the MvMap interface. Consequences: BlockMap (an MvMap) cannot be held, so MultiblockProjection exists as a parallel wrapper (Multiblock.scala:227); BlockMap.decoder permanently returns DecoderUnavailable (:172); and CPCA projection lives entirely outside the MvMap/Decoder contract on raw DoubleMatrix.

Scope: change the wrappers to hold MvMap; delete MultiblockProjection (or reduce to an alias); express a CPCA constraint as a projector MvMap; give BlockMap a real or explicitly-typed-partial decoder.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] BiProjection/CrossProjection hold MvMap; BlockMap flows through them.
- [ ] MultiblockProjection removed or reduced to a type alias.
- [ ] CPCA project/residual/coordinates go through the MvMap/Decoder contract rather than raw DoubleMatrix.
- [ ] MultiblockSuite, CpcaSuite, MapAlgebraSuite green on JVM+JS.
set.title: multivar: one projection contract — BiProjection/CrossProjection over MvMap, not MatrixMap
